name: Porterville Spring 2027

venue.name: Hillside Community Church
venue.address: 1091 W Linda Vista Avenue, Porterville, CA

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortervilleSpring2027#79300-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please. No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.
